cohort: N/A (The study develops a new model and validates it using simulation studies and by applying it to existing longitudinal microbiome datasets, rather than recruiting a new cohort).
finding: The proposed tensor decomposition model, using a semiparametric quasi-likelihood estimation method, is able to recover low-rank structures from microbiome time-course data better than existing approaches, as shown through simulation studies.
mod_finding: The developed method was applied to existing longitudinal microbiome studies to detect global microbial changes associated with infant birth modes.
